ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a pair of similar triangles in the figure. The smaller blue triangle on the left is labeled area A = 30 m², and its corresponding vertical side is labeled x m; the larger green triangle on the right is labeled area A = 40 m², and its corresponding vertical side is labeled 5 m. Reasoning: The area ratio of similar figures equals the square of the ratio of corresponding side lengths. Therefore (x/5)^2 = 30/40 = 3/4. Taking the square root of both sides gives x/5 = sqrt(3/4), so x = 5sqrt(3/4) ≈ 4.33. Rounded to one decimal place according to the problem answer format, x = 4.3.
